QuestInfo.name: Natural Adhesive
QuestInfo.0: The cave fairy #b#p701##k in the #m10006000# seems to have a new request.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p701##k, a cave fairy in the #m10006000#, has been struggling with piecing together the fragments of her map. She asked me to defeat #r40 #o55#s#k east of the village and bring her #b25 #t4000052#s#k to help in restoring it. Looks like that's where I'm headed, then!
QuestInfo.2: As #p701# requested, I defeated #o55#s and gathered enough #t4000052#s to bring back to her.

0.0: Ah, it's you. Thank you again for collecting the fragments of my precious map last time. But what should I do now...? I'm having such a hard time trying to piece the map back together. Is there no good way to fix this...?
0.1: Oh! Now that I think about it, the petals of young #r#o55#s#k that dwell east of the village could serve as an excellent adhesive. They lure prey with their flowers, then trap them with the sticky substance coating their petals.
0.2: I think someone as strong as you could easily defeat them. Would you be willing to help me once more?

yes.0: Thank you! #r#o55#s#k are often seen to the east of the village. Look for the ones whose red flowers have not fully bloomed--they should be easy to spot. Please defeat #r40 #o55#s#k and bring me #b25 #t4000052#s#k.

no.0: I see... I suppose you have your own reasons as well.

1.0: You're back already, and with the #t4000052#s I asked for!
1.1: Thank you! Now I can finally restore my precious map.

item.0: Please defeat the #r#o55#s#k dwelling east of the village and bring back #b#t4000052#s#k. I'm counting on you.

mob.0: Don't forget to take down the #r#o55#s#k as well!
